sections.title: What changed
items: Moodboard works just as before: this release updates the built-in code every Snug app uses to talk to Snug to the version new apps are built with.
Customized your copy? You can skip this one — your version keeps working as it is.

changelog.title: The lighting designer, documented in your file

sections.title: What's new
items: Nothing about the app changes — this release back-fills the designer's wiki and build prompt into installed copies from before docs were seeded at install.

sections.title: What's new
items: Light as mood — describe the evening and the agent becomes your lighting designer.
Talks to your Hue bridge over your own LAN; nothing leaves the house.
Desktop only: the bridge lives on your local network.
